entities.description: A bed with a light wooden frame and headboard, dressed in white sheets and a beige throw blanket, positioned against a wall in a softly lit room.

attributes.position: against wall, right side of frame

entities.description: A person is standing next to a bed, wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled up and beige pants. The bed has white sheets and a wooden frame, with a pillow visible in the background.

clothing.shirt: light blue, long-sleeved, sleeves rolled up

entities.description: A small, round side table with a light wood finish and three slender, tapered legs that splay outward. The tabletop is smooth and circular, supporting a blurred object that appears to be a vase or container with greenery. The table stands on a light-colored floor against a plain white wall.

A light-colored wooden bookshelf with two visible shelves, holding several books. The top shelf has books standing upright, while the bottom shelf has books stacked horizontally. The bookshelf has a simple, modern design with clean lines and a natural wood finish.

An elderly woman with short, wavy white hair is walking forward with a slight downward gaze, supported by a wooden cane in her right hand and a caregiver's hand on her left arm. She wears a light blue button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves and beige trousers, appearing frail with visible wrinkles and thin skin.

A young woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail and wearing black-rimmed glasses is dressed in a light blue short-sleeved medical scrub set. She stands behind an elderly woman, placing one hand on the older woman's shoulder and the other on her arm in a supportive gesture, looking down with a gentle expression.

clothing.top: light blue short-sleeved scrub top with V-neck and chest pocket

attributes.pose: standing, leaning slightly forward, hands on elderly woman

entities.description: A white, multi-paned window with a grid design is shown in a bright, high-key setting, featuring a small metal latch in the center. In the bottom right corner, a cluster of orange flowers with green stems sits on the windowsill, partially obscuring the lower frame.

attributes.hardware: small metal latch visible in center
